name: Semantic Emoji Filter
description: Type what you mean, get the emoji: on-device sentence embeddings (MongoDB LEAF, 23M parameters) rank 200 emoji live in the browser; the Laya decision model re-checks the top hits as a second stage — in the browser too, on the packed Q8_0 lane in a Web Worker, after a one-time 644 MB download.

build.description: Builds the wasm browser distribution with the Laya worker, including the bundled ~92 MB LEAF checkpoint
